data.name: Type2
data.detailed_description: You are the CEO and founder of Selene Dynamics, a space exploration corporation. You have just launched your flagship mission to colonize the moon and mine its lucrative resources. Type2 is a space based city builder where you try to run a mining business on the moon. Through buying, placing, and maintaining various facilities on the lunar surface, you can use your management skills to sustain a colony, expand your company, and of course, make money! As you progress, you will be able to unlock more and better buildings to further your enterprise. This is a demo, as Type2 is still in development so all features may not be fully complete. You can expect to experience the game in roughly 20 minutes. Have fun!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for small-scale 3D scenes; should run on most modern laptops or desktops
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD Radeon RX 460 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: For smoother 1080p gameplay at 60 FPS.
